description: Search ingested documents with hybrid keyword + semantic matching. Use the returned order as the ranking; score may disagree with it. Each has filePath, chunkIndex, text, fileTitle, score (lower is closer), and source (for ingest_data items).

limit.description: Max results (default 10, range 1-100). Lower favors precision, higher recall.

query.description: Search query. Preserve specific user terms (for keyword match); add context when the query is vague (for semantic match).

scope.description: Optional absolute path prefix(es) — one string or a list (unioned) — restricting results to a filePath equal to or under a prefix. "/docs/api" matches "/docs/api/auth.md" but not "/docs/apiv2". Must be absolute (server OS style); a relative prefix matches nothing — derive one from a filePath returned by an earlier query, or omit scope.

name: query_documents
